name: smwpatches-speed-boosters
title: Speed Boosters
description:
This powerup will allow you to have the speed boosters powerup from Super Metroid. It also comes with breakable blocks. I didn't show it in the video, but you can kill enemies when you touch them. Video.

Note: If you shoot up in the air and there is nothing above the player he will keep going up until it runs out. Not really a bug because it happened in Super Metroid as well.
